statistical_scope.acceptance: all three: mean advantage>=.01, Holm adjusted p<=.05, paired interval lower>0
statistical_scope.aggregation: no pooled cross-task sample-size weighting; macro task average descriptive only
statistical_scope.confidence_interval: paired t nominal95percent with7df; not a simultaneous interval
statistical_scope.contrast: free_dual minus comparison; first average two fixed tasks within eachseed, then across8seeds
statistical_scope.core_three_seed_results: descriptive only, no strong significance claim
statistical_scope.dataset_dependence: repeated FSDD recordings are not independent episodes; record source/speaker strata and do not use episode-level binomial CI as population evidence
statistical_scope.missing_or_failed_run: preserve failure evidence; affected comparison incomplete and cannot pass; no silent deletion or retuning
statistical_scope.test: two-sided exact sign-flip of eight paired seed differences; symmetry/sign-exchangeability assumption; Holm family of6

tie_operational_reading: within LR: validation CE, earlier CPU, step; across LR: validation CE then smaller LR; clarified before main outcomes
